facts.fact: The CNT reported that on 20 June 2024 its commissions debated a bill to establish the Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel, an authority the 2016 cybersecurity and personal data protection law provides for, with members' designation and mandates still contested and plenary adoption pending.
